subject.title: fix: provider usage accounting, retry/overflow classification, and output clamping

question: Should the provider API preserve the Anthropic SDK's retry behavior when maxRetries is unset, with the outer OpenClaw retry boundary explicitly passing zero instead?
rationale: Changing the public provider default affects direct callers and availability, while the branch's motivation only establishes that nested retries are undesirable in the outer agent workflow.

options.title: Preserve provider semantics
options.body: Keep unset direct-call behavior intact and pass maxRetries: 0 only from the outer retry-policy owner, while repairing the remaining clamp and configuration defects.

options.title: Narrow the PR
options.body: Land the isolated usage and error-classifier fixes and defer retry defaults, output clamping, and the new compatibility surface to focused follow-ups.

options.title: Approve the new default
options.body: Intentionally make zero retries the provider-wide default only after documenting the compatibility change and proving direct-call upgrade behavior.

recommendation.title: Preserve provider semantics
recommendation.body: Keep unset direct-call behavior intact and pass maxRetries: 0 only from the outer retry-policy owner, while repairing the remaining clamp and configuration defects.

likelyOwner.reason: This person is the strongest available owner for the provider-boundary choice because the branch spans all affected runtime and API surfaces.
